content.title: Impact Aftermath | Private Dilemma to City-Scale Cause
content.summary: Build a private dilemma inside a small protected space, then let a massive outside force displace the entire carrier. Prove the consequence through local impact and a held reaction before a wide reveal identifies the city-scale cause.

quick_start.input_format: Trapped subject + external force moving carrier + local impact proof + reaction stay + wide-angle true cause revealed
quick_start.recommended_input: The glass restorer was fixing the utensils in the small repair cabin. The pressure wave pushed the entire cabin through the flooded hall. After hitting the soft buffer, it stayed for a long time and finally revealed that the giant aquarium above the atrium was ruptured.
required_anchors: Begin with an intimate confined baseline before the large event.
Let one external force visibly displace the established carrier.
Hold one post-impact reaction after motion stops.
Reveal the larger cause only after local consequence is clear.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: Build a private dilemma inside a small protected space, then let a massive outside force displace the entire carrier. Prove the consequence through local impact and a held reaction before a wide reveal identifies the city-scale cause.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Begin inside a tight protected or confined relationship, let one immense external force abruptly displace the carrier, prove impact and disorientation locally, hold a survivor reaction long enough to register consequence, then widen to reveal the much larger environmental cause and aftermath.

invariants.rule: Begin with an intimate confined baseline before the large event.
invariants.purpose: Creates a human scale for the later force.
invariants.ablation_failure: Opening on destruction removes scale contrast.

invariants.rule: Let one external force visibly displace the established carrier.
invariants.ablation_failure: Unrelated disaster inserts do not move the story.

invariants.rule: Prove impact through local physical aftermath.
invariants.ablation_failure: Skipping impact makes the carrier teleport.

invariants.rule: Hold one post-impact reaction after motion stops.
invariants.purpose: Gives the consequence time to register.
invariants.ablation_failure: Cutting immediately to spectacle loses the human cost.

invariants.rule: Reveal the larger cause only after local consequence is clear.
invariants.ablation_failure: An early wide reveal spends the final information too soon.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair whose role is clear without source identity.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A materially new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific location.

slots.name: causal_carrier
slots.constraint: One object, route, mark or device that visibly carries the causal chain.

slots.name: state_change
slots.constraint: Five ordered states with observable handoffs, not a decorative montage.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: A new proof-oriented information order that does not copy source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A held final consequence that resolves or recontextualizes the setup.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of story-world cues supporting each visible change.

anti_copy_exclusions: burning giant machines and falling wreckage
source street destruction and source end card

instantiations.concept: A lone glass conservator works inside a compact museum restoration pod; a pressure wave slides the whole pod across a flooded hall, local cracked seals prove impact, the conservator steadies, and a final wide reveals a ruptured overhead aquarium.
